posts.zh:
dsh-archive-manager 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在设置里增加已归档会话页，可按工作区搜索、恢复和删除已归档会话。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b90077f25945b351a3e5.html
posts.en:
dsh-archive-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b90077f25945b351a3e5.html
